$comment: Copy to iterata.config.json in the project you are designing. Every field is optional; the values below are the defaults plus the two that are worth setting for any real site (hideOnFullPage and sections).
$hideOnFullPage: CSS selectors for position:fixed elements. They repeat down a fullPage capture, so they are hidden for those shots only. A selector that matches nothing prints a warning rather than failing silently.
$sections: Element ids captured as individual crops during the full rig.
